gatekeeper.name: Gatekeeper Aldric
dialogue: Welcome to Sunvale, traveler. Our town has known brighter days.
Thieves of the dark broke in three nights past and took the Sunstone from the shrine.
They fled into the Sunken Crypt to the southeast. Without the Sunstone, our winter will be cruel.

accepted: The Crypt lies beyond the southeastern woods. Descend its three floors.
Defeat the horror at the bottom and bring the Sunstone back to me.
dungeon_cleared: You have the Sunstone! Sunvale is saved. You are the hero we needed.
Thank you, traveler. The shrine shines once more.
complete: The shrine is radiant again. You have our eternal gratitude.

shopkeeper.name: Mara
dialogue: Buy what you need, friend. The Crypt is no place for the unprepared.

healer.name: Sister Brienne
dialogue: The light mends the weary. Let me heal your wounds.
